segments.he:
א.

בְּרִיאוּת הַגּוּף וְחַיָּיו וְטִבְעוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם, הַכֹּל הוֹלֵךְ לְפִי טֶבַע וְחַיֵּי וּבְרִיאוּת אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ.
segments.en: A proposed match which is spoken about, even though the actual match is not completed, this is also from Providence, and the proposal itself has an impact on him and her.

segments.he:
ב.

מִי שֶׁשַּׂעֲרוֹתָיו מְרֻבִּין שֶׁלֹּא עַל־פִּי הַטֶּבַע, זֶה עָלוּל לִנְזָקִים הַרְבֵּה וְלִפְגָעִים רָעִים מֵהַסִּטְרָא־אַחֲרָא, סְגֻלָּתוֹ שֶׁיִּקְרָא הַפָּרָשָׁה שֶׁקּוֹרִין בְּיוֹם־כִּפּוּר.
segments.en: The shroud which is used to cover the face of the bride before the marriage rites ,  has the power of fertility.
Through prayer, one can change his soulmate that was announced in Heaven.
One who is careful not to spend the night or to  house  two couples in one house, through this he merits to have son-in-laws who are  Cohanim (priests)  and/or very important.
When a man marries a woman after the death of his first wife, his first wife is anguished in the grave.
Bodily health, one's life, and a person's nature all go according to the nature, life, and health of one's father and mother.

Someone whose hair is unnaturally abundant, this may lead to great damages and bad injuries from the Other Side.  It is conducive for him to recite the section [of the Torah] that is read on  Yom Kippur .
